title: Flight Search with Hesitation

dialogue.user_annotated: Hi... um, I'm trying to plan a work trip and I could really use some help finding flights.
dialogue.ai: Sure thing! Where do you need to go and when?

dialogue.user: Um, so uh, I need to get to Chicago sometime around... let me think... I believe it's December 12th. Yeah, could you look up flights for that day?
dialogue.user_annotated: Um, so uh, I need to get to Chicago sometime around... let me think... I believe it's December 12th. Yeah, could you look up flights for that day?

acting_notes: Use 'uh' then hesitate briefly before remembering the date.
